signature: SUBROUTINE ZUNMBR( VECT, SIDE, TRANS, M, N, K, A, LDA, TAU, C,

params.name: vect
params.reference:
-   `= 'Q'`: apply Q or $Q^H$;
-   `= 'P'`: apply P or $P^H$.

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q, $Q^H$, P or $P^H$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q, $Q^H$, P or $P^H$ from the Right.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q or P;
-   `= 'C'`: Conjugate transpose, apply $Q^H$ or $P^H$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: If `VECT = 'Q'`, the number of columns in the original matrix reduced by ZGEBRD. If `VECT = 'P'`, the number of rows in the original matrix reduced by ZGEBRD. $K \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: (`LDA`,nq) if `VECT = 'P'` The vectors which define the elementary reflectors H(i) and G(i), whose products determine the matrices Q and P, as returned by ZGEBRD.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. If `VECT = 'Q'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,\mathrm{nq})$; if `VECT = 'P'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,\min (\mathrm{nq},K))$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: `TAU(i)` must contain the scalar factor of the elementary reflector H(i) or G(i) which determines Q or P, as returned by ZGEBRD in the array argument TAUQ or TAUP.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^H \, C$ or $C \, Q^H$ or $C \, Q$ or $P \, C$ or $P^H \, C$ or $C \, P$ or $C \, P^H$.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: On exit, if `INFO = 0`, `WORK(1)` returns the optimal `LWORK`.

params.name: lwork
params.reference:
The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M)$; if $N = 0$ or $M = 0$, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge 1$. For optimum performance $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,N \, \mathrm{NB})$ if `SIDE = 'L'`, and $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M \, \mathrm{NB})$ if `SIDE = 'R'`, where NB is the optimal blocksize. ($\mathrm{NB} = 0$ if $M = 0$ or $N = 0$.)

If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

checks.fortran: ( APPLYQ .AND. LDA.LT.MAX( 1, NQ ) ) .OR. ( .NOT.APPLYQ .AND. LDA.LT.MAX( 1, MIN( NQ, K ) ) )
checks.js: (vect === 'apply-Q' && lda < max( 1, side === 'left' ? M : N )) || (vect !== 'apply-Q' && lda < max( 1, min( side === 'left' ? M : N, K ) ))
checks.rowMajor: lda < max( 1, vect === 'apply-Q' ? min( side === 'left' ? M : N, K ) : ( side === 'left' ? M : N ) )
